summary: Fury Gold Mines Ltd filed a Form 6-K attaching a press release announcing the appointment of Annie Blier as Senior Director, Environment and Permits. This is a routine personnel appointment, not a special situation event. No deal terms, board recommendations, or structural changes are involved. The appointment supports the advancement of the Eau Claire gold project towards feasibility. There are no risk-arb or activist implications. As a foreign private issuer filing under Form 40-F, this 6-K serves as a periodic report of ordinary business activity.
